name: Lucion
source:
The Third Prince of the Empire and Keldran's younger half-brother, his ambition is matched only by his desire to prove himself in magic and academics.

Despite his arrogant attitude and foreign blood, Lucion is fiercely loyal to the Empire and will go to any lengths to protect it.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/teamgalens/status/1663968595469119488]Twitter[/url]]
